description:
One act's card, by registration number. No text: use `get_document_toc` then `get_unit_fulltext`.

`urn_current_edition` is null unless an edition is in force today -- a repealed
act has none; `urn_latest_edition` is the newest text in effect today whatever
the status; `urn_next_edition`, text scheduled to take effect later.

Editions '30000101' and up await a date not yet fixed (e.g. end of martial
law) and are none of these.

relation.description: A `relation_counts` name: list those acts, 50 a page.

name: ua_law__get_document
title: Get Legal Act Card
